idea: Substitution DP: any square of side s in a packing can be replaced by a scaled copy of a packing of m squares, so f(n+m−1) ≥ f(n) − s + s·f(m). Fill a table best[n] bottom-up from the k×k grids, keeping each layout as an explicit tree. At each step substitute into either the largest or the smallest square, and try every m that has already been solved.
